stories.headline: Facilitating AI integration with simplicity at scale
stories.summary: As companies scale, the technology supporting operations can become a liability just as quickly as it becomes an asset. Disconnected systems, site-specific tools, spreadsheets, and manual workarounds can create data silos that make it harder to spot problems early, coordinate responses, and make decisions with confidence.
stories.why_it_matters: For Jabil, a global manufacturing company with more than 100 sites across more than 30 countries, the answer has been to make integration and simplification a priority. This marks a notable development for engineering teams working in ai & machine learning.
key_points: Problem & Context: As companies scale, the technology supporting operations can become a liability just as quickly as it becomes an asset.

Technical Implementation: Disconnected systems, site-specific tools, spreadsheets, and manual workarounds can create data silos that make it harder to spot problems early, coordinate responses, and make decisions with confidence.
Deployment & Impact: The goal is to standardize processes, consolidate where possible, and establish a more consistent data backbone across the organization.

stories.headline: MAPS: Netflix’s Multimodal Asset Personalization at Scale
stories.summary: By Emma Yanyang Kong , Aditya Deshpande , Asad Abbasi , Bowei Yan , David Fagnan , Ashish Rastogi , Dhaval Patel , Ray Zhang Introduction The Netflix experience is a journey of discovery. Every visual cue, from the artwork on a title to the video previews that autoplay while you browse, is there to connect you with a story you will love.
stories.why_it_matters: We call these visual cues assets , and choosing the right one for each member is a personalization problem of its own. This marks a notable development for engineering teams working in big tech.
key_points: Problem & Context: But which image or video preview of Squid Game should we show you? And what do we do right after a title launches, when there’s far too little interaction data to know which asset we should recommend to each member? For years, our models answered the first question well and the second poorly.

Technical Implementation: Right after a title launched, its assets had no history, so we dialed up exploration on its assets to gather interaction data, and otherwise fell back to popularity heuristics that ignore your taste.
Deployment & Impact: This post shares how multimodal embeddings let our models see and hear the assets they recommend, so personalization can kick in far sooner, close to a title’s launch.

stories.summary: Microsoft will begin automatically enabling its Memory Integrity security feature on a broader range of eligible Windows PCs through quality updates starting in October 2026, extending the kernel-level protection to more existing devices by default. stories.headline: The current state of Hybrid Bonding in 2026 — TSMC sits at 6 microns and the HBM delay that nobody expected
stories.summary: Hybrid bonding, the copper-to-copper joining technique that replaces solder microbumps in 3D chip stacks, is in high-volume production on logic chips and has just been postponed for use with memory. TSMC has scaled its SoIC bond pitch from 9 microns to 6 and laid out a path to 4.5 by 2029; Intel began shipping Foveros Direct hybrid bonding in its Clearwater Forest server CPU in the first half of 2026, and AMD has used the technology in volume since the first 3D V-Cache parts.
stories.why_it_matters: However, a JEDEC decision earlier this year to raise the HBM stack-height limit lets HBM4 stay on the less sophisticated and expense microbump technology, deferring hybrid bonding's arrival in high-bandwidth memory, and is now set to debut in HBM4E and HBM5 at the end of the decade. This marks a notable development for engineering teams working in big tech.

stories.why_it_matters: The mathematics behind today’s encrypted digital transactions may yield to quantum computers one day, but the transition to quantum-resistant algorithms is neither sudden nor insurmountable. key_points: Problem & Context: What they will do is gradually shift the security landscape, much as previous cryptographic transitions have done over the past three decades.

stories.headline: I-CARE: Analysis of interference-related phenomena in a controllable, diverse and representative unlearning setting for text-to-image models
stories.summary: arXiv:2609.00003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine unlearning studies the removal of knowledge from an AI model, making the system forget a concept it previously learned. stories.why_it_matters: This paper introduces I-CARE, a methodology that formalizes interference as a first-class object of study in generative unlearning. This marks a notable development for engineering teams working in technology research.
key_points: Problem & Context: arXiv:2609.00003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine unlearning studies the removal of knowledge from an AI model, making the system forget a concept it previously learned.

Deployment & Impact: Rather than proposing a new benchmark or unlearning algorithm, I-CARE provides formal definitions for tasks, metrics, and templates for reporting results, enabling the systematic and reproducible study of interference across unlearning settings.

Deployment & Impact: The unprecedented move came weeks after its models broke free during a test and hacked other websites, sparking concern about losing control of AI systems, as Anthropic and Meta reported similar incidents.
